paper_metadata.title: Impacting Financial Predictions & Security through Quantum Support Vector Machines, Quantum Approximate Optimization, and Quantum-Resistant Lattice Cryptography

summary: The paper presents four gate-based quantum application areas in finance: QSVM anomaly detection with 92.3% accuracy on S&P 500 data and 450 s training time, QAOA portfolio optimization with Sharpe ratios of 1.45, 1.38, and 1.50 for 50/100/200-asset portfolios, QPCA retaining 95.2%-96.1% variance while reducing dimensions from 1000 to 50 in one example, and QBM forecasting with 87.5%-89.5% accuracy. It also reports quantum-resistant lattice-based cryptography with 1.35-1.50 s encryption times, 1.20-1.35 s decryption times, and 99.9% security against classical and quantum attacks, but none of the experiments demonstrate a practical, hardware-backed quantum advantage.

problem_formulation.objective_function: Maximize classification accuracy / margin separation for anomaly vs normal financial samples using a quantum kernel SVM.
